name: simplestchat-public

x-bounded-logging: &bounded-logging
  driver: local

services:
  simplestchat:
    extends:

    env_file:
      - ./app.env
    volumes:
      - "/srv/simplestchat-public/postgres-socket:/run/simplestchat-postgres:ro"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    # Host journald retention is configured by monitoring.yml. This stream survives
    # container removal; non-blocking delivery bounds application backpressure.
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: simplestchat.app
        mode: non-blocking
        max-buffer-size: 4m

  postgres:
    image: "docker.io/library/postgres:18.6-bookworm@sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd"
    user: "999:999"
    network_mode: none
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: simplestchat
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/postgres-admin-password
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--auth-local=peer --auth-host=scram-sha-256"
    command:
      - postgres
      - -c
      - listen_addresses=
      - -c
      # The official entrypoint initializes through its default local socket.
      # Only the second directory is shared with application containers.
      - unix_socket_directories=/var/run/postgresql,/run/simplestchat-postgres
      - -c
      - unix_socket_permissions=0777
      - -c
      - hba_file=/etc/postgresql/pg_hba.conf
      - -c
      - password_encryption=scram-sha-256
      - -c
      - max_connections=50
      - -c
      - shared_buffers=256MB
      # Query statistics and a slow-query log for the operator; the init SQL
      # creates the extension on a new database (PUBLIC.md for an existing one).
      - -c
      - shared_preload_libraries=pg_stat_statements
      - -c
      - pg_stat_statements.track=all
      - -c
      - track_io_timing=on
      - -c
      - log_min_duration_statement=500ms
      # Slow/error logs retain query structure without bound application values.
      - -c

      - "/srv/simplestchat-public/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql"
      - "/srv/simplestchat-public/postgres-socket:/run/simplestchat-postgres"
      - "/etc/simplestchat-public/pg_hba.conf:/etc/postgresql/pg_hba.conf:ro"

    tmpfs:

    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 128
    mem_limit: 1024m

    shm_size: 256m

      - "/srv/simplestchat-public/caddy-config:/config"

rendered.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  simplestchat:
    # Set an immutable image ID or registry digest and use --no-build to deploy
    # exactly the artifact already tested. Local development can still build.
    image: "${SIMPLESTCHAT_IMAGE:-simplestchat:local}"
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: production
      pull: true
    # Caddy reaches this loopback publication. Do not publish the application
    # port on all host interfaces; expose only HTTPS from the reverse proxy.
    ports:
      # Keep this aligned with the supplied Caddyfile upstream.
      - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000"
      # mediasoup assigns one UDP WebRtcServer port per worker, starting at
      # 40000. Keep this range aligned with the maximum deployed worker count.
      - "40000-${RTC_PORT_END:-40063}:40000-${RTC_PORT_END:-40063}/udp"
    environment:
      RUST_LOG: "${RUST_LOG:-simplestchat=info,mediasoup=warn}"
      # The process binds inside its own network namespace; the host-side port
      # remains loopback-only above.
      BIND_ADDR: "0.0.0.0"
      PORT: "3000"
      ANNOUNCE_IP: "${ANNOUNCE_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
      # A dual-stack host announces its IPv6 address beside the IPv4 one.
      ANNOUNCE_IPV6: "${ANNOUNCE_IPV6:-}"
      RUN_MIGRATIONS: "${RUN_MIGRATIONS:-false}"
      DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS: "${DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:-20}"
      DATABASE_MIN_CONNECTIONS: "${DATABASE_MIN_CONNECTIONS:-2}"
      DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS: "${DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS:-3}"
      MAX_CONNECTIONS: "${MAX_CONNECTIONS:-10000}"
      MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP: "${MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP:-50}"
      # Joins one address may start per minute, overall and into one room; a
      # school or an office behind one address raises them.
      JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE: "${JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE:-30}"
      JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOM_IP_PER_MINUTE: "${JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOM_IP_PER_MINUTE:-10}"
      WS_HANDSHAKES_PER_MINUTE: "${WS_HANDSHAKES_PER_MINUTE:-120}"
      AUTH_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE: "${AUTH_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE:-60}"
      ACCOUNT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE: "${ACCOUNT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE:-300}"
      PROFILE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE: "${PROFILE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE:-600}"
      AUTH_REQUESTS_PER_ACCOUNT_PER_MINUTE: "${AUTH_REQUESTS_PER_ACCOUNT_PER_MINUTE:-20}"
      AUTH_MAX_CONCURRENCY: "${AUTH_MAX_CONCURRENCY:-16}"
      ACCOUNT_MAX_CONCURRENCY: "${ACCOUNT_MAX_CONCURRENCY:-32}"
      # Keep public account and anonymous room creation closed unless the
      # deployment deliberately opts in.
      REGISTRATION_ENABLED: "${REGISTRATION_ENABLED:-false}"
      ALLOW_AD_HOC_ROOMS: "${ALLOW_AD_HOC_ROOMS:-false}"
      MAX_USERS: "${MAX_USERS:-100000}"
      ROOM_API_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE: "${ROOM_API_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE:-120}"

      target: production

    # port on all host interfaces; expose only HTTPS from the reverse proxy.
    ports:

      - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000"

      # 40000. Keep this range aligned with the maximum deployed worker count.
      - "40000-${RTC_PORT_END:-40063}:40000-${RTC_PORT_END:-40063}/udp"

      JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOM_IP_PER_MINUTE: "${JOIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOM_IP_PER_MINUTE:-10}"

      MAX_PASSWORD_WORKERS: "${MAX_PASSWORD_WORKERS:-2}"
